title: Keep the negative controls and missing physical theorem
statement: Primitive certificates do not compose into a mixture certificate: the supplied two diagonal rank-one components with Q spanning (1,1) each have zero residual, while their sum has residual norm one. Systematic bias blocks arbitrarily accurate inversion even at rank one. There is no stable finite-precision theorem matching the cumulative exact bound; binary64 diagnostics do not supply it. A perfect endpoint predictor need not plan: the commuting PSD/Set Cover construction retains its restricted ordinary greedy comparison. Adaptive Nystrom, range sketches, affine caching and prior adaptive cross approximation remain credited; a theorem can survive a fixture loss without establishing a general learned-solver advantage.
